title: AVO Per-Video Project
description: Per-video project declaration. This file lives EXTERNALLY, next to the raw footage (in rawDir), NOT in this repo. It declares the inputs AVO works from: the raw-files folder and the optional SFX/music/inserts/graphics/logos locations, plus the provider whose brand and defaults apply. Empty asset fields fall back to the provider manifest (providers/<provider>/avo.provider.json).

$schema.description: Optional path/URL to this schema for editor validation.

provider.description: Provider slug. Resolves against providers/<provider>/avo.provider.json in the AVO repo for brand + routing + defaults.

rawDir.description: EXTERNAL folder holding this video's raw source files. The workflow runs here; edit/ output is created under it. Never inside the AVO repo.

title.description: Optional working title for this video project.

assets.description: Optional per-project asset locations (EXTERNAL paths). Any field left empty inherits the provider manifest's assets value.

sfx.description: External path to SFX for this video.

music.description: External path to music for this video.

inserts.description: External path to inserts/b-roll for this video.

graphics.description: External path to graphics/overlays for this video.

transcription.description: Optional per-project transcription override. Falls back to provider, then avo.config.json.

language.description: faster-whisper language code override for this video.

model.description: Whisper model size override for this video (catalog id: base, small, medium, large-v3).

models.description: Optional per-project model overrides (catalog option ids). Falls back to avo.config.json and .avo/state.json.

understand.description: Qwen tier for watch-skill / THE LOOP (e.g. qwen2.5-7b).

approvalGates.description: Human approval gates after watch-skill LOOP + transcription analysis. Default: require sign-off at all checkpoints.

requireHumanSignOff.description: When true, agent must wait for explicit user approval before promoting resolution or advancing stages.

checkpoints.description: Checkpoints that open a human approval gate.

deliverable.description: Delivery profile hints for loudness preset resolution and manifest.

profile.description: Maps to default loudness reference preset when intent is platform_fit.

audio.description: Per-video audio delivery and restoration settings.

loudness_intent.description: How to resolve integrated loudness target.

loudness_preset.description: Reference preset id (not an official platform requirement).

loudnorm_enabled.description: When false, render skips loudness normalization.

audioQc.description: Audio QC artifact paths and notes.
